text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Mohammed tells United Nations Earth Summit in New York of need to set up an international green force with powers to act in case of environmental crisis.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali says he is confident over the mediating role of James Baker, the United Nations special envoy in Western Sahara.
- Malian Foreign Minister Dioncounda Traore says his country has frozen its support to the Polisario Front since 1995.
- More bags of cocaine wash up Casablanca beach with more than 200 kgs (440 pounds) seized so far.
- National commission in charge of elections follow-up assesses results. It said five people were killed while 1,768 candidates appealed against results.
- James Baker says he made proposals to Morocco and the Polisario Front which can bridge the gap between them.
- Lisbon meeting convened by U.N. envoy James Baker between Morocco and the Polisario Front adjourned after both parties asked for more time to think.
